images.alt: The same select box in Chrome, Safari, and Firefox, Chrome is white with a black border. Safari is grey with no border. Firefox is gray with a black border. They are all slightly different sizes.
Now the select box is the same in all three browsers - it has a rounded corner grey border and a grey downward facing arrow in each one.
